title: Unit – 2 : Session – 7 : SLO – 1 | Representation of decimal numbers in BCD format
sections: In BCD, each decimal digit is represented using 4 bits.
The BCD of the decimal number 12 is 0001 0010.
BCD stands for BINARY CODED DECIMAL.
In BCD, the decimal number 99 is written as 1001 1001.
BCD encoding is mainly used in DIGITAL DISPLAY devices like calculators and digital clocks.

Method: convert each decimal digit separately into its 4-bit binary equivalent and concatenate the groups — this is what distinguishes BCD from straight binary (1508 in pure binary would be 10111100100).
